overview: Roles is under 'Users & roles' in the left menu (company administrators). Its heading is 'Roles and permissions'. It controls what each company role can do, with counters for Configured roles, Users and Protected roles. A permission matrix lists each role in rows and capabilities in columns (for example Dashboard, Create tasks, Tasks for markets, Tasks for users, Sensor administration, Sensor monitoring, Break lists, Subscriptions), with a tick where the role has that capability. You edit permissions per role here.

screenshots.alt: The Roles and permissions page in the MCL web platform
screenshots.description: The MCL web Roles and permissions page: counters for Configured roles, Users and Protected roles; a permission matrix with roles as rows and capabilities (Dashboard, Create tasks, Tasks for markets, Tasks for users, Sensor administration, Sensor monitoring, Break lists, Subscriptions) as columns, ticked where allowed.
